  PROBLEM: The workflow does not pass SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_ATTEMPTS or SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_RETRY_DELAY_SECS to the script, so repository settings cannot tune the retry behavior.
  WHY: The script reads both variables at scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:137-138, but without workflow forwarding it uses its defaults; severity ranged from NIT to MAJOR across reviewers.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:417-447 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The audit workflow is dispatched before pending-marker publication is confirmed, so marker-write failure leaves an audit in flight that cannot publish its result.
  WHY: A recovery attempt can dispatch another audit before successfully publishing the marker, wasting audit runs; severity ranged from NIT to MAJOR across reviewers.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:417, 440 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The audit workflow is dispatched before the pending-marker comment is posted and confirmed.
  WHY: If marker publication fails, the dispatched audit cannot publish its result; recovery can dispatch another audit before a marker exists.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5586-5597 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The workflow step does not forward SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_ATTEMPTS or SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_RETRY_DELAY_SECS.
  WHY: Setting either variable in repository settings has no effect, and the script falls back to its defaults of 3 attempts and 5s backoff base.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Require a confirmed pending marker before emitting audit_dispatched."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh single_pass_gate() — reorder so the marker is posted and confirmed BEFORE the `gh workflow run` dispatch on line 417.
  Evidence of absence: Line 417 calls `gh workflow run "${workflow}" ...` before line 440 calls `single_pass_post_pending_marker "${body}"`. The test `test_pending_marker_write_failure_fails_closed_with_distinct_reason` explicitly asserts `calls.index(["workflow", "run", ...]) < next(i for i, call in enumerate(calls) if call[:2] == ["api", "repos/o/r/issues/42/comments"])`, pinning the wasteful order into the test contract. The current behaviour dispatches the audit first and then attempts to confirm the marker; the issue requires the reverse.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The new tunable env vars SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_ATTEMPTS and SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_RETRY_DELAY_SECS should be operator-configurable through the same repo-variable mechanism that already exposes sibling knobs like SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS and SECURITY_PASS_EXHAUSTED_HEAD_AUDIT_ATTEMPTS.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml lines 5586-5595 (env block of the Single-issue security pass step) and the README.md / agents.md variables tables.
  Evidence of absence: No env row forwards SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_ATTEMPTS or SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_RETRY_DELAY_SECS in the Single-issue security pass step env block, and the variables are absent from the README.md variables table; setting them in repo settings has no runtime effect.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5586-5597 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The workflow step does not pass SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_ATTEMPTS or SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_RETRY_DELAY_SECS into its environment.
  WHY: Setting either as a repository variable has no effect in this workflow; the script always uses its defaults of 3 attempts and a 5-second backoff base.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:417, 440-447; report-side marker check at 521-524 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The audit workflow is dispatched before pending-marker publication is confirmed.
  WHY: If all marker POST attempts fail, the already-dispatched audit has no verified pending marker and its report is refused; a later recovery attempt can dispatch another audit before publishing the marker.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5586-5595 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The workflow step does not export SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_ATTEMPTS or SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_MARKER_RETRY_DELAY_SECS to the script environment.
  WHY: GitHub Actions does not automatically export repository variables, so the helper uses its defaults of 3 attempts and a 5-second backoff base and operators cannot tune retry behavior without modifying workflow YAML.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
